assertions.name: A3_undershoot_no_damping_closes_it
assertions.source: ρ_grad(3)(q0)=[3]_q0=3.34203107815 < ρ_strong(3)=3.8128; ∀ d∈[0,1]: d·[3]_q0 ≤ [3]_q0 < ρ_strong(3). A damping ONLY decreases ρ(3) — it cannot close an anchor that already UNDERSHOOTS. (needed D(3)=1.14086311911 > 1: amplify)

assertions.name: A4_overshoot_at_q0
assertions.source: ρ_grad(4)(q0)=[3]_q0·[4]_q0=15.7395726256 > ρ_strong(4)=13.0316; at the same substrate the A=4 ratio OVERshoots (needed D(4)=0.827951324345 < 1: damp). So damping is the RIGHT sign for A=4, the WRONG sign for A=3.

assertions.name: residual_sign_change_A3_pos_A4_neg
assertions.source: r(3)=ρ_strong(3)−ρ_grad(3)=0.470768921847 > 0 (graded undershoots A=3) while r(4)=ρ_strong(4)−ρ_grad(4)=-2.7079726256 < 0 (graded overshoots A=4): the required correction is + at A=3, − at A=4. A multiplicative damping D(A)≤1 supplies a NON-positive correction at every A ⇒ cannot realise a sign change. Damping is WALLED.

assertions.name: sign_change_robust_to_raw_ame
assertions.source: with RAW AME ratios B(3H)/B(2H)=3.81384892086, B(4He)/B(2H)=12.7230215827: r_raw(3)=0.471817842711 > 0 and r_raw(4)=-3.01655104287 < 0 — same sign pattern. The wall does NOT depend on the isospin/Coulomb correction (anchors are bounds only).

assertions.name: rational_window_brackets_both_anchors
assertions.source: [3]_1.11=3.3421 < ρ_strong(3)=3.8128 (undershoot upper-endpoint) and [3][4]_1.109=15.7021531024 > ρ_strong(4)=13.0316 (overshoot lower-endpoint): the Lean rational window [1.109,1.11] certifies both.

description: Δ_λ magnitude: the A-dependent DAMPING route is WALLED. At the fixed canonical substrate q0 the residual ρ_strong−ρ_grad changes sign between A=3 (+, graded undershoots) and A=4 (−, graded overshoots), so the required correction is non-monotone in A and CANNOT be a multiplicative damping D(A)≤1 (parabolic/skew quotient OR Demazure sub-crystal alike). Companion to Lean QOU.MassTheory.DampingNonMonotoneWall (sorry-free). Robust to raw-vs-corrected AME anchors. scope-(b) structural exclusion of the damping class; nothing wired.
caveats: ρ_strong(3), ρ_strong(4) are DERIVED-ELSEWHERE comparison targets (jet-filtration witness / #3986/#3990); consumed as one-sided bounds, never inverted. No fit; nothing wired.

The exclusion is scope-(b) STRUCTURAL, cited invariant = monotone-≤1 action of a damping together with the q0 A=3 undershoot. It excludes the pure-DAMPING class only; per the permanence principle [A]_q! remains a valid ingredient — an additive many-body TERM that re-weights it (sign-changing in A) is NOT excluded and is the remaining open target.
